data.body:
RP-04 RESEARCH EXPERIMENTS COMPLETE — the earlier preserve-per-job-SSM recommendation is superseded. No research experiment remains deferred.

Op-cert result: current per-job retrieval signs and cleans a 0600 file, but every later job fails if runtime SSM/region/identity becomes unavailable. Deployment-injected startup composition passed from both a file and multiline environment value; missing, ambiguous, non-regular, and invalid sources fail before enqueue/network/workspace creation; common 0644 secret-mount sources still produce a 0600 process copy; the running copy is stable; restart observes replacement; shutdown deletes only the process copy; and no runtime AWS dependency remains. Docker probes on python:3.11, python:3.13-slim, and ubuntu:24.04 confirmed env visibility in inspect and /proc, path-only mounted-file exposure, live mount replacement behavior, and that a 0700 runtime tmpfs clears across container restart.

Application evidence: the census found all 17 expected sensitive inputs without reading values and isolated application-owned cloud-secret coupling to REBAR_OPCERT_SSM_KEY_PARAM. Equivalent CLI/MCP/Python behavior had one fingerprint, reconciler behavior a distinct fingerprint, and credential/client/path changes were excluded while retry/timeout/output/cache/model changes affected it. Focused tracing, all MCP auth facades, op-cert core/app/integrity, review-bot token redaction/metrics, and bridge-runner regressions passed 139/139 in 21.83s. Gitleaks 8.30.1 scanned the full .joe-janitor directory with --no-git --redact and found no leaks.

Bounded real Rebar/PydanticAI calls passed: Anthropic used its native environment chain (21 input/4 output tokens, 1.838s); Bedrock ran with foreign bearer keys removed and used boto3 shared-credentials-file auth (21 input/4 output tokens, 1.953s). Both returned the required result, preserved model provenance, and left monitored credential variables unchanged. No credential value/header/exception representation was emitted.

Hosted canaries:
CI_RESULT {"run_id":"32051556431","status":"passed","duration":93,"fixes_applied":[],"retry_count":0}
CI_RESULT {"run_id":"32051690101","status":"passed","duration":464,"fixes_applied":[],"retry_count":0}
The second was a non-mutating dry-run; scheduled live run 32050784957 had already passed, so no new mutating live run was dispatched. Logs proved masked Jira step injection, signing-key-to-0600-file materialization, bounded reconciler behavior, and scoped GitHub OIDC for AWS metrics.

Recommended resolution 6: retain ADR 0049 algorithm, trust-root/era, single-producer, and SSM-at-rest deployment choices, but remove REBAR_OPCERT_SSM_KEY_PARAM, SsmKeyFetcher, per-job provisioning, and runtime boto3/region coupling from the application. Deployment resolves SSM (or any store) before startup and supplies exactly one key file (preferred) or multiline env value. Service startup validates it, copies it into a process-owned 0700-directory/0600-file runtime before accepting work, and binds signer/principal/push policy context-locally without global os.environ mutation. Current production extends fetch-secrets.sh, mounts the source read-only, and uses a 0700 tmpfs for the runtime copy. Restart/redeploy observes replacement.

Updated .joe-janitor/rp04-secrets-research.md, rp04-adr-research-critique.md, and rp04-composition-readback.md. DRAFT remains gated only on explicit maintainer confirmation of this revised resolution; no ADR, epic, stories, or production code were created.
